title: Diff-MoE: Efficient Batched MoE Inference with Priority-Driven Differential Expert Caching
problem: MoE models require massive expert parameter storage; existing GPU memory management solutions use sophisticated prefetching but suffer communication bottlenecks at large batch sizes
motivation: MoE inference is bandwidth-limited on GPUs; enabling efficient multi-batch inference could unlock higher throughput for LLM serving with resource constraints
method: Differential cache hierarchy: globally-hot experts in high-priority per-layer caches, locally-hot in medium-priority caches under LRU with predictive prefetch, cold experts cached on-demand
key_novelty: First to exploit both global and temporal locality in MoE expert activation; introduces priority-driven differential cache hierarchy
contributions: Identification of global and temporal locality in expert activation patterns
Lightweight predictor for prefetching next-layer experts
2.74x throughput improvement vs DeepSpeed, 2.22x vs Pre-gated MoE, 1.55x vs MoE-Infinity
limitations: Limited to MoE architectures; predictor accuracy not quantified; assumes structured expert activation patterns; evaluation on specific GPU types
